name: @production-ready/platform
description: Shared frontend (UI, system settings pages) + backend (Python) single source of truth for the No.1 Production Ready product family (RAG / NL2SQL / Agent). The Python backend_core package is managed separately with uv under packages/backend_core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @production-ready/ui && npm run build -w @production-ready/system-settings
scripts.test: npm run test -w @production-ready/ui && npm run build -w @production-ready/ui && npm run test -w @production-ready/system-settings
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @production-ready/ui && npm run build -w @production-ready/ui && npm run typecheck -w @production-ready/system-settings
